tabs.description: Getting to know Raghavendra (46, GM-finance at a manufacturing company) & Lakshmi Murthy (43, classical music teacher with forty students) — one college-bound son, a ₹2.4–2.7 Cr budget in the Banashankari–Padmanabhanagar–Uttarahalli belt, and a search filter that rejects more inventory than any bank's: the home must be vaastu-compliant, and not loosely.

buyers.name: Raghavendra Murthy
buyers.description: Prices each shastra requirement separately — door direction is priceless; the pooja room's exact corner is worth ₹5L, not ₹12L. Thirty years in finance, and his wife once described an option contract without knowing it.

tabs.insightTitle: What I noticed while we were searching
tabs.insightDescription: “The Murthys taught me that vaastu isn't superstition bolted onto a purchase — it's an operating system with a 15% market consequence. Their discipline was the professional instrument: a retained consultant, floor plans reviewed before visits, and each requirement priced separately — door direction priceless, the pooja corner worth ₹5L, not ₹12L. The launch-stage insight reorganized their whole search: at a new launch the full matrix opens, and the vaastu premium often collapses to the floor-rise charge. And when deliberation cost them a prime unit, the fix was an option contract in traditional dress — a refundable EOI that holds the queue while the shastra keeps the veto. Rama Rama, finally a system that respects both.”

tabs.adviceDescription: For tradition-anchored buyers, the edge is turning the framework into an instrument: a retained consultant reviewing floor plans before visits, requirements ranked and priced separately, and the launch-matrix as the structural advantage — at a new launch the full unit matrix opens, and the premium often collapses to the floor-rise charge. Hold the queue with a refundable EOI while the shastra keeps the veto, and add the unbrochured dimensions — acoustics, livelihood, light — to the ranked list. The Murthys proved that when the framework becomes explicit, it stops being a constraint and becomes the filter that finds the one the house agrees with.
